  * # Town Clerk

The Town Clerk’s Office serves as the central information point for local residents, citizens at large, departments, boards and committees.  The Town Clerk is the keeper of town records, the chief election official, a member of the Board of Registrars, Registrar for all vital birth, death, and marriage events occurring within the community and those events occurring elsewhere to local residents, serves as Burial Agent, serves as Super Records Access Officer and is the official keeper of the Town Seal.   Administers the oath of office to all elected and appointed town officials.  Purchases, maintains, tests and secures all voting equipment.  Schedules, trains and supervises all election workers and voting precincts in accordance with state and federal regulations. 

 

The Clerk's office maintains the local census and voter registration database, assists with verification of the Federal Census, maintains multiple data bases and issues various licenses and permits such as dog licenses, raffle permits, business certificates, underground and above ground flammable storage registrations, records and maintains Town Meeting votes pertaining to local acceptances of Mass.

# Town Clerk

The Town Clerk is appointed by the Town Manager and holds the rank of department head. 

The Town Clerk serves as the Chief Election Official, Records Access Officer, and the custodian of Town records including Vital Records and other official documents filed in the Town Clerk's Office. She is responsible for the maintenance, preservation and disposition of Town records in her custody.

The Town Clerk and her staff are here to assist you with voter information, voter registration, information concerning vital records, filing intentions for Marriage Licenses, Business Certificates, Special Permits, licensing dogs, census information and many other ways. 

State law provides that the Town Clerk is the keeper of the Town Seal.
